info.name: Strapi Admin Panel Admin Authentication Content Entries API

params.name: pluralApiId
params.description: The plural API identifier of the content-type (e.g., articles, categories, products)

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort results by one or more fields. Use field:asc or field:desc notation. Multiple sort criteria can be provided as comma-separated values or array notation (e.g., sort[0]=title:asc&sort[1]=date:desc).

params.name: pagination[page]
params.description: The page number for page-based pagination (starts at 1)

params.name: pagination[pageSize]
params.description: The number of entries per page for page-based pagination

params.name: pagination[start]
params.description: The starting index for offset-based pagination

params.name: pagination[limit]
params.description: The maximum number of entries to return for offset-based pagination

params.name: fields
params.description: Select specific fields to include in the response. Provide as comma-separated values or array notation.

params.name: populate
params.description: Populate relational fields, media fields, components, or dynamic zones. Use * to populate all first-level relations or specify individual fields using dot notation.

params.name: filters
params.description: Filter entries using operators such as $eq, $ne, $lt, $lte, $gt, $gte, $in, $notIn, $contains, $notContains, $startsWith, $endsWith, $null, $notNull, $between, $and, $or, $not. Use bracket notation for nested filters (e.g., filters[title][$eq]=Hello).

params.name: locale
params.description: Specify the locale for internationalized content-types. Returns entries matching the given locale code.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter entries by publication status. Only applicable when Draft and Publish is enabled on the content-type.

items.docs: Returns a list of entries for the specified content-type. Results can be filtered, sorted, paginated, and populated with relational data using query parameters. By default, responses include only top-level fields without populating relations, media fields, components, or dynamic zones.
